verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a feedback, roadmap and support platform, so a pre-work scope review and approval gate is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no such capability. Status-change webhooks, SLA/trial workflows and public roadmaps are adjacent features, not a step where a product manager approves a task's scope before work begins.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can review and approve the scope of a task before any work begins on it
